name: Hector Morales
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 2A

items.text: Hector Morales is an attorney who has run his own firm since the early 2000s. He attended Senn and Clemente high schools. He works with the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services on child protection and juvenile justice.

sentences.text: Hector Morales is an attorney who has run his own firm since the early 2000s.
He attended Senn and Clemente high schools.
He works with the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services on child protection and juvenile justice.

items.text: He says he wants Chicago Public Schools to use every dollar efficiently. He supports greater community input in budgeting. He proposes cutting duplicative services and central-office positions. He says cost-cutting should protect resources for underserved students. He opposes automatically closing under-enrolled schools. He proposes making them community hubs with additional academic and arts programs. He wants to make music and the arts part of the core curriculum.
